## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected (agent/client integrators, merchants, operators)?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you'd like to see. If this relates to a standard (UCP, A2A, AP2, ACP, MPP, MCP), link the spec version and section.

## Affected surface

- [ ] REST API
- [ ] UCP shim / discovery (`/.well-known/ucp`)
- [ ] A2A adapter
- [ ] ACP shim
- [ ] MCP tool server
- [ ] Provider contracts / adapters (catalog, pricing, tax, geo, payment, receipt)
- [ ] Persistence / reliability (outbox, inbox, dead-letter, reconciliation)
- [ ] Docs only

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches and why they were not chosen.

## Additional context

Links, references, or examples (e.g. spec excerpts, other implementations).
